decisions.proposed_text: Lưu diễn giới hạn đã kết thúc
decisions.reason: The current status repeats the verbose 'thời gian tổ chức' wrapper; the compact wording preserves that the limited tour period has ended.

decisions.proposed_text: Lưu diễn đã hết lượt
decisions.reason: The concise status directly conveys that this tour has reached its allowed attempt count and avoids the wide literal 'giới hạn số lần' construction.

decisions.proposed_text: Xác nhận lưu diễn giới hạn
decisions.reason: For a confirmation dialog title, the start action is evident from the flow; removing 'bắt đầu' reduces width while retaining the limited-tour identity.

decisions.proposed_text: Uma dùng nguyên liệu Thức tỉnh
decisions.reason: Compact 'Uma' is allowed in constrained UI and the shorter verb preserves that these characters use Awakening materials.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma để chọn ngẫu nhiên
decisions.reason: The empty-state message can use compact 'Uma' and drop the helper phrase 'có thể' without changing the random-selection meaning.

decisions.proposed_text: <atlas=PreIn sprite=utx_ico_notice_00/><color=#ff4400> Có thể nhận nhiều thưởng ngẫu nhiên</color>
decisions.reason: Replacing the verbose 'phần thưởng' phrase with compact 'thưởng' reduces width while preserving the notice markup and random-multiple-reward meaning exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Độ nhạy con quay
decisions.reason: In the camera control settings, 'điều khiển' and 'hồi chuyển' are redundant context; the compact label still clearly denotes gyroscope sensitivity.

decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ chọn được khi dùng vuốt
decisions.reason: The current wording is needlessly formal and wide; the compact instruction preserves that this option is available only with swipe controls.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma hát chính
decisions.reason: The Live Theater screen already identifies the song, so 'Bài hát này' is redundant and compact 'Uma' substantially improves fit.

decisions.proposed_text: Không có Uma múa phụ họa
decisions.reason: The song context is already visible and compact 'Uma' is appropriate here; the supporting-dancer meaning remains explicit.

decisions.proposed_text: Đạt 1 điều kiện sau
decisions.reason: Using the numeral and removing the verbose 'trong các' phrase retains the one-of-following-conditions requirement with much less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Uma tương ứng sẽ biểu diễn
decisions.reason: Compact 'Uma' removes unnecessary franchise-name width while preserving that the corresponding character performs.

decisions.proposed_text: 【Cốt truyện chính】Chương {0} {1}
decisions.reason: The unlock-condition context already implies viewing, so 'Xem' is redundant; both placeholders and bracketed category text are preserved exactly.

decisions.proposed_text: Hạng 1 ở {0} trở xuống
decisions.reason: The surrounding unlock-condition list already establishes race context; this compact form keeps the first-place and '{0} or lower' requirement while preserving the placeholder.

decisions.proposed_text: Sao chép sang đội hình khác
decisions.reason: The current formation is already the object of the action, so 'đội hình này' is redundant and can be removed without changing the copy destination.

decisions.proposed_text: Áp dụng đồ thường cho Uma khác
decisions.reason: The compact phrase preserves applying the casual outfit to other characters while replacing the long full franchise noun and verbose outfit wording.

decisions.proposed_text: Không hiện trang phục không mặc được
decisions.reason: The shorter active construction preserves that incompatible outfits are hidden and avoids the wide passive wording.

decisions.proposed_text: Chỉ hỗ trợ một số trang phục
decisions.reason: The Live Theater screen already identifies the current song, so removing 'Bài hát này' preserves the outfit restriction with less width.

decisions.proposed_text: Điều khiển con quay
decisions.reason: The compact established device term is clear in settings; 'hồi chuyển' adds width without useful UI distinction.

decisions.proposed_text:
Phát bài hát ở màn hình dọc
Hỗ trợ camera Trainer
decisions.reason: The two lines can remove repeated 'Bài hát này', 'chế độ', and 'tính năng' wording; the source newline count is preserved and the portrait-mode plus Trainer-camera meanings remain intact.
